candidate: NEXTDC S6 Sydney (3 Broadcast Way, Artarmon NSW 2064): official NSW AddressPoint locator
service: https://portal.spatial.nsw.gov.au/server/rest/services (NSW Spatial Services, Department of Customer Service: NSW_Geocoded_Addressing_Theme FeatureServer layer 1 AddressPoint; NSW_Land_Parcel_Property_Theme FeatureServer layer 12 Property and layer 8 Lot). No open licence is stated in the responses. robots.txt of portal.spatial.nsw.gov.au returned HTTP 404 (no restrictions), checked by the capture tool before the first request and recorded in each capture's robots_checks.

operator_address_source.statement: NEXTDC's technical-specifications brochures carry one national address list; in the 2026 Melbourne brochure (PDF modification date 1 May 2026; the same list appears in the A1, C1 and D1 brochures) the Sydney row reads 'S1 Sydney 4 Eden Park Drive, Macquarie Park NSW 2113 | S2 Sydney 6-8 Giffnock Avenue, Macquarie Park NSW 2113 | S3 Sydney 2 Broadcast Way, Artamon NSW 2064 | S6 Sydney 3 Broadcast Way, Artamon NSW 2064' ('Artamon' sic). NEXTDC's S6 page says S6 is 'Located in Artarmon and adjacent to the S3 Sydney campus' and gives 'Artarmon | 4,000m2 | 13.5MW'.

address_point.query: layer 1 where address LIKE '%BROADCAST WAY ARTARMON%', outSR 4326, GeoJSON
address_point.result: Six AddressPoints on Broadcast Way, Artarmon (1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 5A). The others lie 69.9 m (5 and 5A, one shared point), 96.1 m (1), 115.7 m (4) and 145.9 m (2) away.

selected_point.source: the AddressPoint service's served WGS84 GeoJSON geometry for rid 2979169, copied unchanged (direct geometry)
selected_point.scope: project_locator; official address point for the operator-stated street address, lying at the centroid of the single property and lot at that address. It marks the address point, not a surveyed building outline or data hall.

property_context.result: Exactly one property: propid 3611416, address '3 BROADCAST WAY ARTARMON', propertytype 1, dissolveparcelcount 1, a 7-vertex ring. lot_context.query: layer 8 point-intersects at the selected point, outSR 4326
lot_context.result: Exactly one lot: 3//DP270714 (lot 3, DP270714), planlotarea 3877.385 m2; its ring is identical in extent to the property ring (area 3877.4 m2). None of the AddressPoints for 1, 2, 4, 5 or 5A Broadcast Way lies inside it.
